rationale: Fresh is a material condition, not a moisture-removal process.
Pressing separates liquid and retained fractions through pressure.
Threshing separates grain or seed from other plant material.
Rendering uses governed heat treatment and separation.
Chopping cuts material into smaller pieces.
Crushing reduces particle dimensions using pressure.
Grinding or milling reduces particle size in dry or wet processing.
Flour milling separates flour, bran, and intermediate fractions.
Decortication separates an outer covering from retained material.
Pelleting agglomerates material through a die.
Extrusion shapes material through a die.
Rendering separates stabilized protein, fat, and water fractions.
